description: Consolidate the extension/developer guide into a single canonical doc. Currently docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md and docs/ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md cover overlapping territory (both explain adding nodes, with slightly different code patterns). Merge them into one authoritative docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md that covers: adding a new graph node, adding a new agent tool, adding a new query type, and adding a new ingestion source. Remove docs/ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md. Update all inbound links (docs/README.md, AGENTS.md references if any).
steps: Read docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md and docs/ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md to identify the differences. ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md has a more detailed checklist and uses the newer Runtime[GraphContext] pattern, while DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md uses older **deps pattern. The merged doc should use the current pattern from ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md.

Rewrite docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md as the single canonical extension guide. Structure: (1) Adding a New LangGraph Node (use the Runtime[GraphContext] pattern from ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md with the full checklist), (2) Adding a New Agent Tool (from current DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md), (3) Adding a New Query Type (from current DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md), (4) Adding a New Ingestion Source (brief section explaining how src/ingestion/unified/ can be extended, referencing the CocoIndex flow pattern), (5) Dependencies and DI (from current DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md, updated to mention GraphContext), (6) Testing (combine testing guidance from both files). Include the Code Locations table from ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md.

Update docs/README.md: change the 'ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md' link in the Architecture & Design section to point to docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md with an appropriate description like 'Guide for extending graph nodes, tools, query types, and ingestion'.
Search for any other inbound links to ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md (grep the repo) and update them to point to DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md.
acceptance_criteria: docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md covers: adding graph nodes (with Runtime[GraphContext] pattern), adding agent tools, adding query types, adding ingestion sources, DI/dependencies, and testing
docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md uses the current Runtime[GraphContext] node signature pattern (not the old **deps pattern)
docs/README.md no longer references ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md; it references DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md for extension guidance
No broken links to ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md remain in the repo
verification: Run the Python relative-link checker script from docs/engineering/docs-maintenance.md section 7
findings: Successfully merged ADD_NEW_RAG_NODE.md into DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md. The merged doc uses the current Runtime[GraphContext] pattern throughout. Removed duplicate DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md listing from the Quality & Evaluation section in docs/README.md. Pre-existing broken links in docs/superpowers/plans/ are unrelated and noted in FEAT-003 findings.
